description: This file defines the AzureApi class, a specialized extension of OpenAIApi, providing methods to configure and interact with Azure OpenAI services, including URL setup, message filtering, and streaming chat completions.

classes.name: AzureApi
classes.description: A class extending OpenAIApi to facilitate interaction with Azure OpenAI, including URL configuration, message filtering, and streaming chat completion.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes AzureApi with Azure configuration, setting up the OpenAI client.

methods.name: _isAzureOpenAI
methods.description: Checks if the API type is 'azure-openai' or 'azure'.

methods.name: _getAzureBaseURL
methods.description: Constructs the base URL and default query parameters based on Azure configuration.

methods.name: _filterEmptyContentParts
methods.description: Removes empty or whitespace-only text parts from message contents to ensure compatibility with Azure models.

methods.name: modifyChatBody
methods.description: Modifies the chat body by filtering out empty content parts.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks from Azure OpenAI, filtering out chunks with no choices.
